description: Source file defining the DrupalEntityLinkSuggestions plugin for CKEditor5, handling link suggestions, previews, autocomplete, and form submission logic.

classes.name: DrupalEntityLinkSuggestions
classes.description: CKEditor5 plugin class for managing Drupal entity link suggestions, previews, and autocomplete integration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up link UI, autocomplete, and preview handling.

methods.name: _handleEntityLinkPreviews
methods.description: Configures link preview button behavior, updating href and label based on metadata.

methods.name: _enableLinkAutocomplete
methods.description: Sets up autocomplete for link input, handling selection and entity metadata.

methods.name: _handleExtraFormFieldSubmit
methods.description: Intercepts form submission to add entity attributes to the link command.

methods.name: _handleDataLoadingIntoExtraFormField
methods.description: Binds entity data properties to the link command for data loading.

methods.name: _isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Static method to validate if a URL string is an HTTPS URL.
